app_release_notes: v1.8.0 - Predicted DOPE now includes spin drift, Coriolis and aerodynamic jump. Range & DOPE is laid out like a range card, with your own distances and a Clicks column. New Basic and Technical views decide how much prints on your Pocket Card. Fixed: on a 1/8 or 1/4 MOA turret the click counts were wrong on the phone companion and on the printed Pocket Card. Fixed: the wind clock now reads as the direction the wind comes from.
